abstract:
BACKGROUND: FOLFIRINOX and gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel are widely used first-line regimens in metastatic pancreatic cancer (mPC); however, direct real-world comparisons and clear criteria for selecting between the two remain limited.
METHODS: In this retrospective cohort study, we used a multicenter real-world data registry to compare outcomes between patients with mPC treated with FOLFIRINOX and gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel and explore associations between genomic alterations and survival outcomes. The cohort included patients with mPC treated with FOLFIRINOX (n = 272) or gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel (n = 280) between 2010 and 2022 at tertiary referral cancer centers. The primary outcomes were overall and progression-free survival. Available next-generation sequencing results were used to explore potential prognostic biomarkers.
FINDINGS: The FOLFIRINOX group was significantly younger than the gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel group. Before propensity score matching, the FOLFIRINOX group showed significantly longer median overall and progression-free survival. Afterward, survival outcomes no longer significantly differed. Next-generation sequencing panel data were available for 57 and 29 patients in the FOLFIRINOX and gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel groups, respectively. In the gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel group, ARID1A and RNF43 mutations were correlated with shorter progression-free survival. Genomic alterations in the TGF-β pathway were associated with longer overall survival with gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel.
INTERPRETATION: No statistically significant differences in OS or PFS were observed between FOLFIRINOX and gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel after propensity score matching. The exploratory genomic associations require validation in larger prospective cohorts before their potential role in treatment selection can be established.
FUNDING: This work was supported by grants from the National Research Foundation of Korea (RS-2024-00,335,625, RS-2024-00,342,475, and NRF-2021R1A2C1008898), Korea Evaluation Institute of Industrial Technology (20,023,781), and Korea Health Technology R&D Project through the Korea Health Industry Development Institute (HI22C047400).
key_points_ko: 총 552명의 전이성 췌장암 환자(FOLFIRINOX 군 272명, gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel 군 280명)가 분석에 참여했습니다.
성향 점수 매칭 전에는 FOLFIRINOX 군이 중앙 전체 생존기간(OS)과 무진행 생존기간(PFS)에서 더 우수한 결과를 보였습니다.
성향 점수 매칭 후에는 두 치료 요법 간의 생존 결과에 유의한 차이가 없었습니다.
gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel 군에서 ARID1A 및 RNF43 유전자 변이는 짧은 무진행 생존기간과 상관관계가 있었습니다.
summary_ko: 연구진은 다기관 실제 임상 데이터(real-world data)를 활용하여 전이성 췌장암(metastatic pancreatic cancer, mPC) 환자에게 사용된 1차 치료 요법인 FOLFIRINOX와 gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel의 치료 성적을 비교했습니다. FOLFIRINOX 치료군은 gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel 치료군보다 연령이 유의하게 낮았습니다. 성향 점수 매칭(propensity score matching) 전에는 FOLFIRINOX 군의 전체 생존기간(OS)과 무진행 생존기간(PFS)이 더 길었으나, 매칭 후에는 두 치료 간 생존 결과에 통계적으로 유의한 차이가 없었습니다. 탐색적 유전체 분석에서는 gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel 군에서 ARID1A 및 RNF43 변이가 짧은 무진행 생존기간과 연관된 것으로 나타났습니다.
title: FOLFIRINOX vs. gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel for metastatic pancreatic cancer: A real-world study
title_ko: 전이성 췌장암에서 FOLFIRINOX 대 gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel: 실제 임상 데이터 연구
